title: notSoSmartOCR
description: Built a document-intelligence product that turns complex scans into structured, reviewable outputs. It combines orientation correction, layout detection, Falcon OCR 1.5, and selective LLM refinement for handwriting and ambiguous regions, and shows page-level evidence, per-block confidence, tables, and Markdown output.

title: LevelHead: Deskew Before You Classify
description: A training-free method for page deskewing and orientation classification. LevelHead levels the page with a spectral deskewer first, then lets any frozen classifier or VLM vote over the four quarter turns of the level page. On pages at any angle it lifts four Qwen3-VL models from 41.9% to 84.6% and four orientation classifiers from 71.9% to 85.2%.

title: MycoGate-VL
description: Detects and categorizes hallucinated character spans in vision-language responses across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. Combines multilingual detectors, a learned clean-document gate, visual category supervision, and scorer-aware output serialization.
image_alt: MycoGate-VL example: the claimed count of eight lights is annotated as a hallucinated span with miscounting and invention labels

title: Mixing Matters? Position Bias Across Sequence Mixers
venue: Accepted · PriGM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026, Paris
description: A paired study of position bias across Transformer, Mamba, and hybrid language models. One answer-bearing passage moves through ten positions of a fixed long context while everything else stays the same. Pythia favours the opening and the Mamba checkpoints do not; the paper reports this as a model-family difference, not an isolated architecture effect.
image_alt: Accuracy by evidence position for Pythia 2.8B, Mamba 2.8B, and Mamba-2 2.7B

title: Post-Audit Mirage: Identifiability Limits of Offline Agent Verification
venue: Accepted · Who Verifies the Agents? Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 (Poster)

gallery.label: The mirage
gallery.alt: A safe world and a harmful world give an offline verifier the same evidence and the same result, but deployment reveals delayed harm in only one of them
gallery.caption: Same offline evidence, different real truth.

gallery.label: Monitor
gallery.alt: Fresh group-labelled outcomes pass through a group-aware monitor that can deploy, hold, request more evidence, or report unsupported
gallery.caption: A fail-closed monitor that acts only on fresh post-update evidence.

description: A matched-world benchmark for offline agent verification. A safe and a harmful deployment can leave byte-identical audit records while needing opposite decisions, so no offline verifier can tell them apart. Across authorization, scheduling, and shared-capacity environments, the paper shows when fresh post-update evidence restores the decision, and gives a fail-closed monitor that deploys, holds, asks for more evidence, or reports unsupported.

title: RDAN-GRPO
description: Rubric Decoupled Advantage Normalisation GRPO is a rubric-based reinforcement learning repository for aligning LLMs with complex, open-domain instruction-following tasks. It improves performance on public instruction-following benchmarks.

title: Drishti
description: A scalable remote-sensing pipeline integrating EarthMind-4B, RemoteSAM, and a BERT classifier for unified satellite-image analysis. DRISHTI stands for Deep Remote-sensing Intelligence System for Holistic Task Integration. Awarded a silver medal at Inter IIT Tech Meet 14.0.

title: Tech-Enhanced AI Interview Learning Platform
description: Developed an interview practice platform that generates diverse, topic-specific questions and uses NLP to analyse spoken responses, identify grammatical errors, and provide corrections after the interview.
